about_the_game:
Astral Sanctum is a retro-inspired puzzle platformer where every room is a test of magic, timing, and creative problem-solving. Play as a young wizard navigating a labyrinth of ancient chambers, each packed with traps, monsters, and secrets waiting to be uncovered.

Harness your magic to create or destroy blocks, fend off enemies, and unlock paths forward. But plan your moves carefully, resources are limited, and every level is a puzzle you’ll need to crack to advance.

Key Features

  • Puzzle-driven platforming
    Each room is a handcrafted challenge requiring clever thinking, precise movement, and careful use of magic.

  • Master magical abilities
    Conjure blocks, break walls, freeze foes, and manipulate your surroundings with a versatile set of spells.

  • Retro spirit, modern feel
    Classic puzzle-platformer gameplay reimagined with smooth controls, clean visuals, and engaging design.

  • Challenging enemies and hazards
    Face off against enemies, traps, and shifting environments that test your reflexes and strategy.

  • Secrets and collectibles
    Explore hidden paths, uncover bonus challenges, and power up your character with rare items.

  • Level-based progression
    Focus on completing individual levels for progression, with optional challenges for extra rewards.

  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Processor: Intel Ivy Bridge/Zen 3 or Newer

short_description: Astral Sanctum is a puzzle platformer where you conjure blocks, manipulate magic, and navigate challenges in dangerous, trap-filled levels. Outsmart enemies and master each room’s unique hazards to progress through an ever-evolving maze of mystical trials.
